title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-07-13
content:
Infrastructure Weekly Update - 2026-07-13

Owners: Priya Nair (lead), Marco Alvarez, Jin Park, Erin Zhou
Team: eng-infrastructure
Status: Final

Summary/Highlights:
- Completed canary rollout of the A100->H200 driver and kernel tuning in us-west2 canary pool; early latency tail improvements observed (~12% p99 reduction for 8k-context workloads).
- Provisioned 48 additional H100s in eu-west1 to address Q3 reserved-capacity demand from Enterprise customers.
- Mitigated two small transient region-level networking flaps impacting autoscaling in ap-southeast1; root cause identified as mis-specified BGP community on partner peer.
- Capacity forecast for July-August updated (see forecast section) — expect peak-week demand to exceed baseline by ~22%; recommend short-term burst reservations and enabling queue-based soft-autoscale.

GPU Fleet
- Fleet health: 99.88% availability across all pools this week. Marginal improvement in cuda driver recovery time after rolling kernel upgrades to 535.x.
- Hardware changes:
  - us-west2: Canary pool (48 GPUs) moved to H200; no data-plane regressions. Metrics: avg token throughput +7%, p99 latency -12% for generation jobs with batch size <=4.
  - eu-west1: Added 48 H100 GPUs to dedicated capacity (reserved) to meet committed enterprise contracts. These are behind dedicated-host routing and tagged for low-latency routing.
  - ap-northeast1: Decommissioned 8x older V100 nodes as scheduled; rebalanced caching nodes to avoid cold-KV cache hits.
- Failures/Incidents:
  - 2026-07-10 03:20 UTC: Node hardware ECC errors in us-central1 (4 GPUs). Impact: degraded throughput on a subset of dedicated racks for ~45 minutes while we reprovisioned. Action: replaced hardware, added automated ECC alert to SRE runbook. Linked: JIRA INFRA-4287.

Regions & Networking
- ap-southeast1 networking flaps (2026-07-11): partner BGP community misconfiguration caused transient path changes, triggering autoscaler thrash. Mitigation: applied temporary route dampening and engaged partner NOC; full fix deployed 2026-07-12. Post-mortem in progress. Action owners: Jin Park + Partner NOC.
- Edge caching: We rolled out a change to prefix caching TTLs for embeddings routes (reduce TTL from 15m -> 5m) to improve memory churn on high-cardinality workloads. Monitoring shows cache hit-rate stable at 82% with reduced memory pressure.

Capacity Planning & Forecast
- Short-term (next 4 weeks): Q3 pilot customers + sales-driven trials expected to increase GPU hours by ~22% on baseline. We recommend:
  1) Approve a 6-week burst reservation with cloud provider for 120 H100-equivalent GPUs (cost estimate attached in Confluence).
  2) Enable queue-based soft-autoscale for non-latency-critical batch inference routes to smooth demand spikes.
- Long-term (Q3): Evaluate additional dedicated racks in us-west2 and eu-west1 targeting H200 and H800 (internal evaluation ongoing). Decision gate: post A/B performance evaluation of H200 vs tuned H100 (code: INFRA-PERF-2026-07).

Operational Notes & Runbook changes
- Autoscaler: Added a safeguard to prevent <1 minute scale-down events after a scale-up to avoid thrashing. Deployed as feature flag to prod; monitor over next 2 weeks. Owner: Marco Alvarez.
- Alerting: Added ECC-Rate alert at 5 events per hour and a separate GPU-IOPS-degradation alert. Owners: SRE oncall rotation.
- DR drills: Next full-region failover drill scheduled for 2026-08-03 (scope: us-west2 -> eu-west1; execs invited). Prep tasks assigned.

Incidents & Postmortem work
- ap-southeast1 autoscaler thrash (2026-07-11): Impact: ~10% increased 95th-latency for ~2 hours for some customers. Root cause: partner BGP misconfig + aggressive scale-down policy. Status: remediation complete, postmortem draft in Confluence, action items assigned to Jin Park and Network partner.
- us-central1 ECC hardware event (2026-07-10): Small throughput reduction for 45m; hardware replaced, ECC alerting updated. Postmortem: low-risk, follow-up: vendor firmware update scheduled.

Standup notes (this week)
- Mon: Review of H200 canary metrics; no regressions, proceed to graduated rollout planning.
- Wed: Forecast sync with sales; confirmed enterprise commitments for eu-west1. Approved reservation ask.
- Fri: Incident review; finalized autoscaler short-term fix and scheduled DR drill.

Action items (owners)
- Marco Alvarez: Monitor autoscaler flags and evaluate thrash metrics (due 2026-07-20).
- Jin Park: Complete ap-southeast1 postmortem and close actions with partner (due 2026-07-16).
- Erin Zhou: Coordinate H100 reserved capacity onboarding for new enterprise customers in eu-west1 (due 2026-07-21).
- Priya Nair: Prepare Q3 capacity recommendation brief for executive review (due 2026-07-22).

Notes/Questions for leadership
- Approve short-term 6-week burst reservation (120 H100-eq). Finance and procurement have estimated cost; see Confluence linked artifact.
- Sign-off on DR drill scope and exec invite list.

Attachments/Links
- Confluence: GPU Fleet Upgrade Q3 (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFRA/GPU+Fleet+Upgrade+Q3)
- JIRA tickets: INFRA-4287, INFRA-4279 (autoscaler thrash), INFRA-4264 (reservations)
- PRs: runtime/pull/1012 (kernel selection tuning), infra-ops/pull/314 (autoscaler dampening)

End of update.
